# Groove Scope Measurements

> Open reference measurements of vinyl playback systems created with Groove Scope by Michelangelo Canonico and Direct Sound Records.

Groove Scope Measurements is the public technical archive for Groove Scope. Each record combines human-readable interpretation, machine-readable JSON data, and the original Groove Scope report. Unknown setup fields are explicitly marked and are never guessed.

Direct Sound Records is the publisher. Michelangelo Canonico is the creator, developer, and lead measurer. Resonance Lab is the related Direct Sound Records application for tonearm and cartridge resonance planning.

## Core resources

- [Dataset home](https://directsoundrecords.github.io/groove-scope-measurements/): Public index and project identity.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DirectSoundRecords/groove-scope-measurements): Complete versioned archive, documentation, schema, reports, and data.
- [Measurement GS-2026-0001](https://directsoundrecords.github.io/groove-scope-measurements/measurements/GS-2026-0001.html): 1 kHz reference check covering speed, wow and flutter, crosstalk, balance, distortion, and harmonics.
- [Structured measurement JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DirectSoundRecords/groove-scope-measurements/main/measurements/GS-2026-0001/measurement.json): Machine-readable record.
- [Measurement GS-2026-0002](https://directsoundrecords.github.io/groove-scope-measurements/measurements/GS-2026-0002.html): Thorens TD160 Super / SME III / Ortofon OM10 1 kHz reference check with Perreaux EP2.
- [Structured measurement JSON GS-2026-0002](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DirectSoundRecords/groove-scope-measurements/main/measurements/GS-2026-0002/measurement.json): Machine-readable record.
- [Dataset CSV index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DirectSoundRecords/groove-scope-measurements/main/data/index.csv): One-row-per-measurement catalogue.
- [Direct Sound Records](https://directsoundrecords.com/): Official publisher website.
- [Resonance Lab](https://directsoundrecords.com/resonance-lab/): Related application.

## Interpretation rules

A measurement describes one documented setup and session, not a universal product specification. Preserve measurement IDs, source provenance, software and analysis-method versions, diagnostic classifications, and limitations when citing or analysing the data.
